---
name: A button doesn't work
about: A key does nothing, or the wrong thing, on your device
title: "<button> doesn't work on <device>"
labels: profile
---

**Device:** manufacturer and model (for example "LG OLED55C1PUB")

**Profile:** the one you used, by name or id (for example "harmony:498661")

**Button:** which one (for example "Back")

**What happened:** nothing, the wrong action, or it works only sometimes

**Anything else:** a button that does work instead, or what the device's own remote does
